page_title: MON 1-3 EMP | Monza v Empoli 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Livio Marinelli has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.

90+2' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick has been awarded to Empoli.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Luca Caldirola (Monza) tested Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
84' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) coming on for Jacopo Fazzini.
82' Stefano Sensi (Monza) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
80' Alessandro Nesta decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Bianco will be replaced by Stefano Sensi (Monza).
77' Monza seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
74' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
71' Alessandro Nesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrea Petagna (Monza) replacing Keita Balde.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Patrick Ciurria (Monza) replaces Gianluca Caprari.
70' Sebastiano Esposito will be replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli).
70' The resulting corner from Liberato Cacace (Empoli) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
69' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) fails to score a rebound with his right foot as he misses the target.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
65' Andrea Carboni (Monza) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
65' Monza will take a corner kick.
64' Dany Mota (Monza) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

59' 1 - 3 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box from the corner but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:3.
59' The ball goes behind for a corner. Monza will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
55' Substitution. Dany Mota (Monza) on for Kevin Zeroli.
55' Alessandro Nesta prepares a substitution. Tomas Palacios is replaced by Luca Caldirola (Monza).
51' 1 - 2 Mattia Viti (Empoli) converts the resulting corner kick with a precise header! He jumped highest to meet the ball and powers the ball behind the keeper into the net.
51' Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.
49' 1 - 1 Goal! Jacopo Fazzini puts the ball across the area and Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 1:2.
48' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
46' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Luca Marianucci and he is replaced by Saba Goglichidze (Empoli).
46' Liam Henderson comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
42' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
40' Kevin Zeroli (Monza) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
39' Liam Henderson (Empoli) jumps into a tackle and Livio Marinelli signals a foul. It's a free kick to Monza, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
37' Keita Balde (Monza) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
37' Andrea Carboni (Monza) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
36' Keita Balde (Monza) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach produces a wonderful reflex save.
33' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) commits a foul and Livio Marinelli immediately signals a free kick.
30' 1 - 0 Samuele Birindelli (Monza) collects a sweet pass inside the penalty box and smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish!
28' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
24' Luca Marianucci (Empoli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
23' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Empoli.
19' The Empoli players are exchanging some short passes.
17' Liam Henderson (Empoli) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
15' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monza, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Monza have a free kick.
14' The Monza players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Liam Henderson (Empoli) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Livio Marinelli signals. A free kick to Monza.
8' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
6' Semuel Pizzignacco pulls off a glorious save! Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves.
3' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Monza will take the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli was nominated as the referee for this game.
